measured_definition: A stage is measured only if its verdict depends on at least one market-derived operand compared with a source predicate and can fail on real data.

operands.name: open_location
operands.predicate: JR pp.36, 38, 42 open vs prior RTH H/L/VA
operands.verdict_rule: recorded; missing prior VA is unknown not fail

operands.name: high
operands.verdict_rule: pass if formation span exists; no episode otherwise

operands.name: sweep_at
operands.predicate: RR-03 sweep search from 09:00 JR p.20
operands.verdict_rule: no episode without a sweep; pass on the sweep bar

operands.name: sweep_depth
operands.predicate: F11/RR-06 record depth, not a fail gate

operands.name: edge_reclaimed
operands.predicate: RR-06 reclaim of swept edge JR p.71
operands.verdict_rule: recorded on trigger; fail lives on confirmation if unreclaimed

operands.name: ob_2m
operands.predicate: TBR p.27 O056 C2 sweeps C1 and C3 closes beyond C2 opposite extreme on 2-minute bars
operands.verdict_rule: pass if any of ob_2m/ob_3m/ob_5m/rejection_block is true; fail if all false; unknown if no complete window

operands.name: rejection_block
operands.predicate: TBR p.29 close of the next candle beyond the sweep candle wick

operands.name: stop
operands.predicate: TBR pp.27-28 stop beyond C2/sweep extreme, one tick OD
operands.verdict_rule: pass when a stop price is computed from the sweep bar

operands.name: plus_0_5
operands.predicate: RR-06 +0.5 W beyond the swept edge JR p.71

management.unobservable: author scale/partial/amend records are not on the Phase 1.5 tape (TBR pp.24, 36-37). Stage omitted, never pass.

operands.name: at_rth_open
operands.verdict_rule: pass if the sweep bar starts at 09:30 ET; fail otherwise

operands.name: opening_sweep
operands.predicate: first 09:30-09:40 bar trades through a 6-9 edge
operands.verdict_rule: no episode if neither edge is swept

operands.name: stop
operands.predicate: beyond the 6-9 edge, one tick OD

operands.name: expiry_ns
operands.verdict_rule: recorded from the session clock, not a label

management.unobservable: 09:40 close of the outbound is recorded as expiry_ns on risk; later management is not on the tape.

operands.name: range_frozen
operands.verdict_rule: fail if the formation is not frozen before the band is used

operands.name: band
operands.verdict_rule: pass when o015 returns a band

operands.name: sessionstat_coincidence
operands.verdict_rule: recorded; unknown if no injected/native box

operands.name: after_1000
operands.predicate: RR-03 / dated examples after 10:00 JR pp.25-26
operands.verdict_rule: pass if first band touch is at or after 10:00; no episode before 10:00

operands.name: ob_2m
operands.verdict_rule: any of 2/3/5m OB or rejection-block; fail if all false

operands.name: remaining_draw
operands.predicate: TBR p.21 remaining draw to the opposite 6-9 edge
operands.verdict_rule: pass when the opposite edge exists

management.unobservable: continuation vs reversal after the band is discretionary (TBR p.21).

operands.name: box_observed
operands.predicate: RR-04 London box 02:00-03:00 ET JR pp.50, 63-64
operands.verdict_rule: pass if the 02:00-03:00 span exists; no episode otherwise

operands.name: box
operands.verdict_rule: label of a measured span, not the trigger

operands.name: level
operands.verdict_rule: pass on a contact of those levels

operands.name: kind
operands.predicate: sweep or touch of the location; pass requires sweep. Window 03:00-06:00 is where the trigger may occur, not the trigger.
operands.verdict_rule: fail if the contact is a touch without a sweep

operands.name: box_edge_swept
operands.predicate: JR pp.63-64 box low/high raid (including 02:00-03:00). A session with no box-edge sweep has no pass (RR-04).
operands.verdict_rule: fail the side if that box edge was never swept

operands.name: ob_3m
operands.predicate: TBR p.27 3-minute reversal favourite. London pass requires ob_3m.

management.unobservable: one-pass-per-side cap is an OD bound from the author's London examples, recorded as first_pass_already_taken when a second pass would otherwise fire.

operands.name: open_location
operands.predicate: RR-08 / TBR pp.12-14 outside prior value in the continuation direction
operands.verdict_rule: no episode unless open_location is below_pdl/below_val (short) or above_pdh/above_vah (long). F08 10:00 reduced-expectation is recorded on trigger, not a context fail.

operands.name: level
operands.predicate: RR-02 EQ and quadrants both sides, bound to continuation side TBR pp.12-15
operands.verdict_rule: pass on a contact of eq/q1/q3 on the allowed side

operands.name: kind
operands.predicate: touch or sweep of the location

management.unobservable: reduced ambition after 10:00 is labelled on trigger; later management is not on the tape.

operands.name: open_location
operands.verdict_rule: no episode unless below_val or below_pdl

operands.name: purged_high
operands.predicate: TBR pp.12-15 overnight high > prior RTH high (OD stand-in A2 for all-significant-overnight-liquidity)

operands.name: purged_low
operands.verdict_rule: side bound: purged_low permits short. No qualifying purge yields no episode (RR-02).

operands.name: compressed
operands.predicate: TBR p.12 shrank overnight vs prior RTH width
operands.verdict_rule: recorded OD, not a fail gate

operands.name: level
operands.predicate: RR-02 EQ/quadrant on the context-bound side

management.unobservable: add-on size after the first entry is not on the tape.

operands.name: open_location
operands.predicate: RR-08 inside prior value JR pp.36, 38, 42
operands.verdict_rule: no episode unless inside_value. Both sides permitted (RR-02).

operands.name: kind
operands.predicate: JR p.3 touch EQ is not a trade; pass requires a sweep of EQ
operands.verdict_rule: fail if kind is touch; pass if kind is sweep

operands.name: ob_2m
operands.predicate: F11; touch EQ is not a trade JR p.3

management.unobservable: two-way EQ grinding and personal 20-minute stop (JR p.3) are not on the tape.

reference.unobservable: P-zone generator unknown (F17, RR-05). Printed fixture boxes are the only reference. Never pass a generated zone.

operands.name: inside_box
operands.verdict_rule: skip the box if never inside

operands.name: absorption
operands.predicate: RR-05 OD TBR p.35 body<=0.6 vol>=1.5x14
operands.verdict_rule: unknown if volume average missing; skip the box if never absorbed

operands.name: proxy
operands.verdict_rule: tied to absorption; not a constant pass

operands.name: stop
operands.predicate: stop beyond the printed box RR-05

objective.unobservable: 3-day pivot is a printed fixture field when supplied (RR-05). Unprinted targets stay unknown. No generator.

context.unobservable: zone generator is proprietary (F17). Context is the printed fixture identity.

management.unobservable: trailing to the 3-day pivot is not reconstructed without the author's ticket.
